purpose: Generate role-specific front reference images from text only; no LoadImage/reference input.

parameters.style_prompt: original Midjourney-inspired fantasy character concept art, detailed painterly game illustration, polished material rendering, clear readable design
parameters.composition_prompt: One character only, full-body front view, standing neutrally with arms relaxed, centered with the full head and feet visible, clean warm-gray studio background, soft even studio light, crisp silhouette, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

cases.character_prompt: An adult woman swordswoman with a distinct heart-shaped face, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, straight brows, and a calm focused expression. Glossy black hair in a high ponytail bound with red silk cord, two cheek-length locks, a decorative comb visible behind the head. Ivory wrapped tunic, deep-navy split riding coat with red lining, layered pleated waist panels, lacquered black shoulder guard, red sash, dark fitted trousers, black reinforced boots. Jade waist charm, red sleeve knots, silver collar crest, long katana in a black lacquer scabbard at the left hip and a short utility blade at the back waist.

An adult woman battle mage with a distinct oval face, warm freckled skin, green-hazel eyes, and a composed expression. Copper-red hair in a high braided ponytail, three thin temple braids and loose jaw-length curls. Ivory high-collar blouse, burgundy velvet waistcoat, long asymmetrical wine-red coat with split tails and embroidered cuffs, charcoal pleated trousers, dark knee boots, narrow brass shoulder plates, wide leather belt with potion loops. Cobalt crystal pendant at the sternum, brass rings on the right hand, red belt tassel, carved ash staff topped with a blue glass orb and a small spellbook pouch at the left hip.
